summary: Join our Advanced Financial Econometrics Modeling Training Course to gain in-depth knowledge and practical skills in financial modeling and data analysis.
lede: Advanced financial econometrics helps financial, quantitative, and risk analysts test market data, model volatility, and produce forecasts. The course covers stationarity testing, ARIMA and VAR forecasting, and ARCH/GARCH volatility estimation using financial time-series data. Learners also practice residual diagnostics and forecast evaluation to explain model results for investment, treasury, or risk decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who analyze financial data, build econometric models, or validate risk and forecast outputs in operational settings.
modules: Volatility Modeling with ARCH and GARCH
prerequisites: You should have a working knowledge of statistics, linear regression, and basic financial concepts such as returns, variance, and correlation. Familiarity with Excel and at least one analytical environment such as R, Python, Stata, or EViews is recommended for the hands-on labs. Prior coding experience is helpful but not mandatory for the conceptual parts; the applied exercises assume you can follow guided workflows and interpret model output.
